content: ऊह् I. €1 <ab>U.</ab> [ऊहतिं-ते, ऊहाञ्चकार-चक्रे, ऊहितुम्, ऊहित] .²1 To note, mark, observe; <ls>Av. 20. 131. 10</ls>. .²2 To guess, conjecture, infer; अनुक्तमप्यूहति पण्डितो जनः <ls>Pt. 1. 43</ls>. द्रुतधृतलिपिविद्यं वीक्ष्य वैलक्ष्यमूहे <ls>Śiva B. 9. 74</ls>. .²3 To comprehend, conceive, perceive, expect; ऊहांचके जयं न च <ls>Bk. 14. 72</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">3. 48</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 123</ls>. .²4 To reason, deliberate about. .²5 To reckon upon (with <ab>loc.</ab>) .²6 To wait for. .²7 To be regarded as. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab> .²1 To change or modify. .²2 To push, thrust, remove (with a <ab>prep.</ab>). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to reason, think, infer, conjecture; प्रच्छन्नमप्यूहयते हि चेष्टा <ls>Ki. 16. 19</ls>.
